items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Joe Smith was what you would call an all around trumpet player, more or less.

ctx.x: I told him, I said, 'Wire Joe,' Joe Smith, and he wired Joe, and Wendell Culley.

ctx.x:
He was the brother
